values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754161 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet, primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp; ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754161 (Facilities: 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite', 'Ramp (Gravel)'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the North Fork Blackfoot River with designated primitive camping, 3.5 miles south of Ovando on the Ovando-Helmville Road. Non-motorized watercraft only on the Blackfoot and its tributaries. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp. Added a 25-ft trailer limit (the page now publishes 'Trailer Length is 25ft.'; the note said none was published) and the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected (trailer limit) and trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees.
